children: Halozyme proposes a $1.05 billion offering of convertible senior notes due 2033, plus a $150 million option to initial purchasers.
Offering: $1.05B aggregate principal of convertible senior notes due October 1, 2033, offered to qualified institutional buyers.
Optional additional: 13-day option to initial purchasers to buy up to an additional $150M of notes.
Terms: senior unsecured, semi-annual interest; conversions settled in cash and/or shares at company’s election.
Hedging and capped calls: company expects to enter capped call transactions to limit dilution and fund their cost from proceeds.
Use of proceeds: fund capped calls, repurchase certain existing convertible notes, general corporate purposes and potential strategic transactions.
